title: ✨ [performance improvement] Bolt: Skip expensive BVH queries for exterior voxels
abstract:
💡 What: In `solid` voxelization mode (when `narrow_band` is not used), we short-circuit the exact Signed Distance Field (SDF) calculation for voxels determined to be strictly outside the mesh, assigning them a dummy positive value to fail the `sdf <= 0.0` check.
🎯 Why: Calculating the exact distance from an arbitrary point to a mesh (`distance_to_local_point`) is an expensive BVH query. For a solid voxelization without a narrow band, we only care about voxels *inside* the mesh, so calculating the exact distance for exterior voxels just to discard them is redundant work. 
📊 Impact: Skips O(N) BVH queries for exterior voxels in sparse grids. While benchmark improvements on small dense cubes are marginal due to most volume being interior/surface, real-world models with significant empty exterior space in their bounding boxes will see measurable speedups.
🔬 Measurement: Verified with `cargo bench` and validated no regressions with `cargo test`.
